# 🛡️ MobArmyWars

**MobArmyWars** is a server-side PvE battle plugin for **Paper servers**, inspired by the German YouTuber **BastiGHG's MobArmyBattle**.


The game is played by two teams. During the preparation phase, players collect equipment, resources and mobs by defeating them. After that, each team configures up to **three mob waves** using the mobs they collected.

These waves are then sent into an automatic arena battle against the enemy team. The team that defeats the opposing mob army first wins.

## 🎮 Gameplay

1. Join a team
2. Collect gear, resources and mobs
3. Configure your mob waves
4. Start the arena battle
5. Defeat the enemy team's mob army first


![Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9a2610c4ffe3490cce3a2fec352040c3ec192c8b.jpeg)
 
## ⭐ Extra Features

- Separate lobby, team, Nether and arena worlds
- Server-side world creation and reset systems
- Team backpacks for shared item storage
- Optional block randomizer
- Resume system for continuing events
- Configurable world settings, including difficulty
- Optional arena monster compass
- GUI-based settings and wave configuration
- Team equipment selection
- German in-game messages and GUIs

## ⚙️ Compatibility

This is a **server-side Paper plugin**.  
It is not a client mod and does not belong in the `mods` folder.

- Requires **Paper 26.1.2**
- Requires **Java 25**
- Not compatible with pure Spigot/Bukkit
- In-game language: **German**


![GUI 1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ad2ee02dfe6922e99cdb8197fbcd99ead3c33aac.jpeg)


![GUI 2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1efa48c14bfa6effa62680a93c2bb3df3eb6cc5d.jpeg)

## ⌨️ Commands

```text
/optionen
/team join rot
/team join blau
/team leave
/mobstatus
/arenasummary
/resume mobarmy
/mobarmy resume
/setphase <lobby|teamwelt|waveauswahl|arena>
/reset <arena|lobby|teamworld|playerdata>
```

## 🚧 Planned Features

- Additional arenas
- Chest randomizer
- Custom mob spawn order based on click order
- Improved start countdown logic
- English in-game language support

Planned features may change during development.
